notes.title: Meet the release update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32615215/829cc60a8ff7c6ec17afafc4eef21cabce4ae868.jpg[/img]

We're leaving the Early Access all players who bought the game before this date are granted with an unique dress for the captive.Thank you for your support!

[h1]What's happened with the game during Early Access?[/h1]
[list]
[*] we rework the whole visual part
[*] we added new territories where basttes take place
[*] we added new enemies
[*] we added new mechanics
[*] we added entertainment part into the game
[*] we totally change the tutorial - now it's separate training level
[*] we made huge changes to the gameplay and many bugfixes
[/list]

[h1]What's new in this update:[/h1]
[list]
[*]  There is a new room in the Castle - Dressing Room. There are 6 skins availalbe for the captive  - you can buy them for game money + Early Access dress. You can change clothes for the captive woman there by clicking the suits

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32615215/76a6c32608c170bb47121db485933c50ebd8378c.jpg[/img]

[*] Added start cutscene in Orc's settlement
[*] Added final cutscene, where you'll be offered a map for all the lands. It will alow you to navigate to any location you want from the Castle.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32615215/d17eee9e9f84840d207a631724bb17e576f3f563.jpg[/img]

After completing the main 30 levels you will be able go to any map to earn money/achievements or just to play. Each of them will have bats and mages.

Also there will be some changes in the Castle after that ;-)
[*]  Kiugur (big green orc in business suit) now has voice! He will speak from time to time and react to the victories or defeats
[*] added missing localization (including text-meshes)
[*] added new dance to Orca's Castle actions
[*] added action "Follow me" to Orca's Castle action
[*]  added 25 new achievements!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32615215/9d42dfea90e629f2d8245b21453837140e1bd4f0.jpg[/img]

[*] now you can increase the bet in dice game
[/list]

[h1]Fixes and changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] replaced logo texture in the Castle
[*] fixed smal houses textures in Mage Village
[*] increase overlap of some buttons to avoid multiple change of animation poses on fully tracked fingers
[*] added hit castle effects 
[*] improved fuction of chosing points for cleaning for Orca so now there should be zero values
[*] added additional checking in the spawn enemies fuction so there should be new mobs after wave's end usually happened on defeat in highlevels
[*] added additional spawn points  - now they are different for usual mobs rotations and for unique mobs rotaions - this should help prevent stacking when 2 enemies spawn at 1 point
[*] fixed mage attack the Balista tower - now he will ignore it
[*] fixed progress reset during quitting the game from the board on the table
[*] optimized text-meshes
[*] increased minesweeper reward for victory to 50 coins
[*] fixed that when you second time started playing dice you didn't pay money at all if you didn't change the bet
[*] other multiple minor fixes
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32615215/13f907f6668e4a997d573b8c21a7b3a572f88435.jpg[/img]

P.S.: we couldn't raise price at the moment we release out of Early Access otherwise there won't be discount to celebrate it, so the price will increase from $6.99 USD to $10.99 USD when the discount is over

[*]  now the tower book shows upgrades for firerates, price etc.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Qx5OiPdwRNY39u8bkF/giphy.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update 13
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32615215/a7407c33ad8d0ed02757b1b376eb246f2439f196.jpg[/img]

[h1]What's new[/h1]
 - new  way of giving commands to Orca - just take the right statue with animation and she will do it. If you want to stop the process take it again

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/H8LMqpQsdA2dNKM3LT/giphy.gif[/img]

- watch button on hand now calls for 2 more buttons: one for turn on/off the tower health widgets and the other is to turn/off the range outline of all towers (mind that there is no function for it in the Castle for now)

notes.title: Update 9
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/69zK1ktqYUSJpCG08n/giphy.gif[/img]
[h1]New enemy[/h1]
Energy Mage for Mages Village map - he sucks energy form the ground and converts it to the damaging balls. He attacks ony your towers and if there's no towers he will damage the Castle.
His base damage is 3 points. Base health is 7. He attack from the far, he doesn't walk but flies from one tower to another, his energy allowes him fly through his friends. Only death can stops him as he has resistance to the freeze.

[h1]Towers upgrade
[/h1]
Now you can upgrade all your towers and the Casle using the Shop.
Just overlap your hand with the item you want to upgrade (they show you the level you will be) and then click to buy.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/7zViN3B9umPw7On4IK/giphy.gif[/img]

Level of upgrade is not limited for now. The appearance of the towers stays the same - it will change depending on the level next update.

[i][h1]What happens when I upgrade the Castle?[/h1][/i]
 The health of the Castle will be increased to +5 for each level, that is level 1 gives you 15 health, 2 - 20, 3 - 25 and so on.

[i][h1]What happens when I upgrade the towers?[/h1][/i] 
the health of the tower will be increased to +3 for each level and the damage of the tower will be increased to "base damage multiplied by the level" (except freezing wall).
Example: Base damage of the arrowed wall is 1.2  and base health is 5. Level 1 gives you 2.4 in damage and 8 health, level 2 - 4.8 and 11 and so on. 

[i][h1]Can I downgrade the towers?[/h1][/i]
 No

[h1]Other:[/h1]
- the castle's health is no longer an integer, although you will still see the whole number, this is done to calculate the damage more correctly
- archer damage is decreaed to 0.5 points
- now you can see tower level numbers on the table
-  fixed teleport issues on Mages' village map

notes.title: Update 8
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32615215/08ef2695cc2d024a93d26d83ab2bea7de131217e.jpg[/img]
[h1]What's new[/h1]
This update provides you with a new map for waves 26-30. This is a mages' village.
There is no new enemies in this update for the village (the rotation of mobs is the same as for 21-25). Next update the enemy for this location will be ready and now you can enjoy catching the bats (we hope you like it)

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
- fixed the bug when in training level you couldn't take the bat in your hands  (when you start the training wave and they fly to the castle)

[h1]Changes[/h1]
- we change the rotation of enemies - now it is not cycled like before. If you go further the last available levels for the waves (now it's further than 30) the last waves rotation will be repeated forever (before the rotation started from the beginning)
It is temporary. Later when all levels will be ready we change it.

notes.title: Update 7 - Road to Magic
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3krBmIwqFwxt8sL9ea/giphy.gif[/img]
[h1]What's new[/h1]
- new location for waves 21-25.
- new enemy for the location - bats
They are flying enemies, so you cannot kill them with usual towers you have.
You should catch them - just squeeze your hand and release - they will die.
- bats are represented on the demonstration table in the tutorial room so you can train in catching and releasing them. They are also added into the rotation for training level - so you can catch them when  they fly.

[h1] Changes [/h1]
- increased the amount of money for the  minesweeper win (from 5 to 15)
- we change the way the enemies spawn - the higher the waves the more enemies will spawn, also now 3 enemies  can be spawned simultaneously.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
- fixed bug when enemies could attack after death (for example, the archer continued shooting). Zombies are bad idea.
- the AI of Ork representative rewritten so he will behave himself more correctly. Fix of animation will be in the next updates.
- some adjustments on all the maps connected with the changes of AI

notes.title: Update 6
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32615215/94c03c37e9e0bd65c98a9211fdfc3af833fb6c24.png[/img]
[h1]What's new[/h1]
- new location for waves - 16-20 - Arena. This is the place of tanks - big and strong warriors.
This is the last enemy which existed in the game before maps updates. Starting with the next update there will appear new ones.

- we replace the small servants with the big one on the maps - Road to arena and Arena itself. 
Why? It was rather good to watch like little humans go forward and back, minging the ore and bringing the sack to the castle, but as the level of enemies grows and the more towers was placed on the battlefield  they became a problem. If you build mazes - they  go into these mazes and blocked the way, if you block their way they damaging and destroy your towers - so that's why we decided to make them more real  - and they will not bother you from defeating the castle on high levels anymore (they are still small on the 1-10 waves maps)


[h1]Fixes[/h1]
- change some movement logic of enemies when colliding with each other so we hope that they will be smarter and could continue movement without stucking

[h1]Archer[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32615215/37d533ce692069089e52b00a8b36cd5227977259.png[/img]
- the fire rate of archer was descresed to 1.5 (one arrow in 1.5sec)
- the arrows were made more bright, so you could notice them
- the fly speed of arrows were reduce twice
- added sound of shooting
All these changes to archer should help you to identify her shooting and to decide what to do.
Notice that she is a long range enemy so she can shoot the castle from a distance if you block her way. If she reaches the castle, she will make several shoots so try to avoid it.

[h1]In future [/h1]
- there will be a map with all your conquered lands and you can return to previous maps to play there any waves
- there will be cutscenes before transition to the new map (now there's just music)

notes.title: Update 5 - Road to Arena
notes.content:

notes.title: Update 4 - Forest
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/9PkhPLgEjWli7Yelvi/giphy.gif [/img]

We decided to divide big updates into not big ones and here is one of them.

[h1]What's new[/h1]
You are a conquerer so you need to capture new location. You founded a castle there and have to defend it - 5 waves will be enough to break enemies. After that you will proceed to the next location.

So this update contains new map - Forest which will be available after 5 waves.

And we made a system of changing your location and enemies on it.

The runner you could see after killing orcs actually from Forest area so this is her native location where she feels fine and she doesn't like that somebody trying to occupy her home. She will gently try to bother you - no physical hurt, only mental.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32615215/63f0723d29f63a88f512048c38f34406ec1e3b77.jpg[/img]

[h1]Other:[/h1]

notes.title: Hotfix 2.1
notes.content:
Fixed forever incompleted tutorial. That voice sounded each time you completed the wave. Hearing voices is a bad thing so we've fixed that but you should listen to it only once and never again after that.

Corrected the update of the Leaderboard in Minesweeper game when you have the same time over and over again. Now if the current time is equal to your best time - the LB will update with the current result. So if someone has the same time before you, you will be higher in place. If someone took your place just repeat (or decrease) your result to be the first.

Hey, we really need your feedback!

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
When you start playing the game you may run out of money really quickly and the only way to get more money was to kill mobs and wait for servant to mine something during the wave. Or you may sell the weapon but then you won't be able to kill mobs to get money from them....

That's why we made another way of gaining gold in the game - you don't even need to be on the battleboard map.
Instead of entertaining with the captive try to win the minesweeper!
Yes.
It is traditional minesweeper in VR!

Some FAQ:

The most convenient way of opening the cells is with your hand - just touch the cell and press click.

When you near the Sapper-board you will see that some items is attached to your left hand - it is a Flag - to mark the bombs - and the question.

All other things are pretty the same - put all the Flags and open all the cells  without explosions.

Each victory will bring you 5 gold - not much but better than nothing.

There is a leaderboard - and you can compete with other player who is faster. Only your best result will be written in the Leaderboard.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/8BlCQmzmdu4UjeBeMC/giphy.gif[/img]

So what else?
- some minor fixes of gameplay
- fixed some localization issues
- some adjustments to AI (will they be a little smarter?)

P.S.: there is one new achievement!

notes.title: Update 1!
notes.content:
So this is the first update in Defendion. We've been preparing the update for long enough and changed a lot too. For those who opt in the test branch it is not a surprise, but let's summarize all.

[h1]Castle[/h1]

First of all, we remade the entire castle - just completely changed the map.

Now it is a full-fledged and large throne room with chairs, tables, torches, knights (iron) and, of course, a throne. At the moment this is the first place where a player appears (in the future this will change, as the story cutscene will be added at the beginning)

The game now has the soundtrack, which sounds in the castle and which the captive dances to. The commands that can be given to Orca remain unchanged, but we changed the way the commands run, but more on this later.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32615215/439cd00c0fdef608764ae4a6d5c98f5039e8a737.png[/img]


[h1]Training[/h1]

Secondly, the level of training (tutorial) has been completely remade. Now it's a room inside the castle with interactive tables, where you can see and try to do that or another action in the game. "Live" hands will show how to do it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32615215/246ec1f2dfbb4c86f671ad01592a5a64b780e223.png[/img]
         

We added a demo table that demonstrates all types of structures and their work, it also spawns mobs and they go from the right side of the table to the left. With each mob killed, their level rises very quickly and you can see how weapons kill them and use it on the main map.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32615215/26009e8a03d2728a505f7cc675ca71452d3499b6.png[/img]

A training table on which you can try real defense on a small map without losing money and inventory, remained almost the same (except common for all levels changes)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32615215/7268bfe3e8376d202a1acb1d7e48b411dfc13a37.png[/img]


[h1]Controls[/h1]

We also changed the controls and removed the hand-menu: instead of the pointer that was used before, all the elements are now interactive - so you have to touch them to press the buttons, and in order to avoid accidental clicks there are windows confirming certain actions.

Interactive elements are also done in order to be conveniently managed from any touch controllers. By the way, Defendion has standard Oculus Rift and HTC Vive support and now it supports Windows Mixed Reality - everything is tested. Also for the last two, the position of the hands has been corrected - so that the hands in the game are felt more real.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32615215/27e34df4147ff64e688a66c712d2fda0648cf692.png[/img]

Now you purchase the item when you take it from the table, and sell item - by moving it to the basket.

We heard the feedback of the players and made it possible to rotate the structures after installation on the battlefield - now you can organize defense more quickly - simply by installing the structures on the field and then rotating them towards the mobs. This also can be done during the battles.

There is no opportunity to improve the structures and the castle yet, but it will definitely be implemented in the future.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32615215/fb94ce8fbafbaab3a08bbe90252f76e287c3d09a.png[/img]
      
[h1]New enmeies[/h1]
There are 2 new evemies in the game - a tank and a runner.

[h1]Tank[/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/g4Olo6vRCnOllk3XBC/giphy.gif[/img]

A tank has much more basic health compared to the usual Orc. And he looks more impressive and bigger than others. But he goes slower. He attack with a hammer or a hammer with a shield. It is easy to notice him and plan your defense. Since it will take a long time to kill him, probably the best practice is to freeze and surround him with other structures with the possibility of passing between, otherwise he will destroy your weapons. 
You will not see him during the first several waves, otherwise it will be rather difficult to win, but be prepared - starting with 5 waves he will appear.

[h1]Runner[/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/RHKOVhDuMJLPYAV4NB/giphy.gif[/img]

A runner has very little health, but she runs very, very fast. So quickly that only the flaming wall can inflict damage on her. The time of freezing is reduced for her. She has daggers and she can be called an avenger, because she has a chance to appear only after you kill any orc.

[h1]Main map[/h1]

The changes on the main map, where the table with the battlefield, is not so much and mostly visual - it's lighting, and new buildings (for example, towers with flags - which, by the way, will be included in the gameplay in the future), the textures in many meshes have changed , fixed geometry, added information about the money that you own directly on the battlefield, torches, etc.

Also, the adjustments to the gameplay, the spawn rotation of the mobs, and a few adjustments to the balance (both for old and new mobs) have been made - now the waves should go more dynamically, although you may become more likely to lose if you organize the defense poorly.

In the future this map will undergo further changes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32615215/b765aadaa9b6351cbf1ac50344aec3a02872be3f.png[/img]
       
[h1]Other[/h1]
— added german localization
— optimization (reduce polycount, fixed geometry)
— many many different fixes, from flying hair to incorrect numbers (for example, the beginning of the game with 2 waves) - the description will take too long, so you just have to believe that the game has become much better :-)

We'll be glad to hear your feedback!
